name: Maratona da Cidade do Rio de Janeiro
typicalWeather: About 16–20 °C at the 05:30 start, rising to 22–27 °C late in the race
summary: The Rio de Janeiro Marathon is part of a four-day running festival. The marathon runs along the coast from Barra da Tijuca to Aterro do Flamengo. The 2026 course had about 110 m of climbing.
courseHighlights: Start at Praia da Reserva in Barra da Tijuca
Joatinga Tunnel, which leads into São Conrado
Leblon, Ipanema and Copacabana beachfronts, with a turn at Leme
Finish at Aterro do Flamengo, near Marina da Glória

paceStrategy.summary: The course is flat and near sea level, but the race starts before sunrise and the second half gets warmer. Run the first 10 km a little under control and keep energy for the heat on the beachfront.

segments.terrain: Flat roads through Barra da Tijuca, ending with the Joatinga Tunnel
segments.advice: Start at goal pace or slightly slower, because cool air and fresh legs make fast running feel easy.
Do not bank time here; hold your goal pace.

segments.terrain: Leblon, Ipanema and Copacabana beachfronts, with the biggest crowds
segments.advice: Stay on pace, drink at every aid station and use shade where you can.
Expect warmer weather; keep the effort steady and push only in the last 3 km.

fuelingNotes: The race starts at 05:30 and the temperature rises later, so plan to drink at every aid station. A third-party guide notes that the back half is warm, so take your gels before you feel low.
tips: Check the route before race day: the 2027 course is still to be confirmed and the 2026 course was revised
The marathon finish is in the Aterro do Flamengo, near the Monument to the Brazilian Expeditionary Force
A third-party guide says an official shuttle runs to the start in Barra da Tijuca, leaving the city centre around 3:00 to 4:00 am
Expect warm and humid weather and consider a light hat or cap

faq.question: Is the Rio de Janeiro Marathon flat?
faq.answer: Mostly. A running guide gives about 110 m of total climbing on the 2026 course, which starts at sea level and follows the coast.

faq.question: When is the Rio de Janeiro Marathon held?
faq.answer: The 2027 festival is planned for late May. In some years it has been held in early June, so check the official site.

faq.question: Where does the Rio de Janeiro Marathon start and finish?
faq.answer: It starts at Praia da Reserva in Barra da Tijuca and finishes at the Aterro do Flamengo.
